method: Full-text inventory and extraction over distinct main blobs/current narratives, prior exact original-pointer validation and semantic reconciliation of obligations by current domains. Extraction counts are not individually audited bugs or a guarantee that every sentence is understood.

local_drafts.scope: Untracked original draft read; preserved, not staged or promoted to published evidence.

limits: Main-history witnesses, not every abandoned branch or private chat/attachment ever created.

Generated callable tables and repeated narrative revisions are corpus context, not independent obligations.
